name: telegram
description: Interactive Telegram channel: talk to the agent from your phone via qwen serve channels.
post_install: Easiest: ask the agent 'set up telegram' — it has the telegram-setup skill and walks you through it.
Manual: create a bot with @BotFather, put the token in .env (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN), add the channels block from docs/telegram-channel.md to .qwen-docker/settings.json.
Set allowedUsers to your Telegram user id (strict allowlist — a channel is a remote shell into this agent).
Restart the agent container: docker compose restart qwen-agent.
